job.question: In the Police Retirement System of St. Louis (PRS-STL) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the principal actuary have?
job.expected_facts: A minimum of five years of professional actuarial experience, plus a minimum of five years of experience testifying before legislative and administrative bodies.
job.acceptance: Five years professional actuarial experience is the core number. A complete description may state the separate five-year testimony requirement; these are not additive ten years and may overlap. Credentials are optional for this question.

reviews.reason: This is a Contra Costa County Employees’ Retirement Association RFP for master custodian services, not the Police Retirement System of St. Louis actuarial RFP. Its five-year requirement applies to a custody account administrator, not a principal actuary; it provides no principal-actuary experience requirement.
quotes: REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS FOR MASTER CUSTODIAN AND RELATED SERVICES
Contra Costa County Employees’ Retirement Association

The account administrator (the individual primarily assigned to CCCERA’s account and in charge of the day-to-day contact) proposed for this engagement must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience (three [3] years at the proposing company) in custody.
